100: A boy who loves music sneaks into the land of the dead to find his great-great-grandfather.
A bald villain adopts three girls so he can steal the moon, helped by little yellow henchmen.
A clumsy panda who works in his dad's noodle shop is picked as the chosen kung-fu warrior.
A cocky race car gets stuck in a tiny town on Route 66 and learns to slow down.
A girl and a demigod with moving tattoos sail across the ocean to return a stolen stone heart.
A woman wants a coat made of puppies, so she kidnaps 99 of them.
200: Monsters scare children to power their city, until a little girl wanders into the factory.
A Scottish princess refuses to get married, and her mother ends up as a bear.
A boy and his brother's huggable inflatable robot form a superhero team.
A teenage girl turns into a giant red panda every time she gets emotional.
An arcade game's bad guy is tired of being the villain and sneaks into a racing game.
A rabbit becomes a police officer and teams up with a con-artist fox.
300: A girl's parents turn into pigs, so she takes a job in a bathhouse for spirits.
A small-time boxer gets a random title shot and celebrates by running up some steps.
A shark keeps eating swimmers, and the mayor refuses to close the beach.
A man with a broken leg watches his neighbours through a camera lens and decides one is a murderer.
A retired agent with 'a very particular set of skills' has 96 hours to find his kidnapped daughter.
Commandos in a jungle are hunted one by one by an invisible alien trophy hunter.
400: A young Black man visits his white girlfriend's family, and they're a bit too welcoming.
A divorced dad dresses up as an old Scottish nanny so he can see his kids.
A genius mathematician at Princeton sees a roommate and a government agent who aren't really there.
Two kids find a board game that brings the jungle, a stampede and a hunter into their house.
Two nerdy teenagers try to buy alcohol for a party with a fake ID that says 'McLovin'.
A lonely New York night-shift driver talks to himself in the mirror: 'You talkin' to me?'
500: An Iranian couple's divorce gets messy when the carer they hire for his father is accused of stealing.
A troubled teenager's imaginary friend, a giant rabbit, tells him the world ends in 28 days.
A father convinces his son that their concentration camp is an elaborate game with a tank as the prize.
A son hides the fall of the Berlin Wall from his mother so the shock doesn't kill her.
A jet-lagged American actor in a Tokyo hotel befriends a young woman who also can't sleep.
A Los Angeles cab driver is forced to drive a hitman to five hits in one night.
